top_stories.title: Okta Launches Agent SSO to Standardize Digital Labor Identity
top_stories.summary: Okta announced the general availability of Agent SSO on August 24, 2026, a product designed to manage AI agent identities distinct from traditional service accounts. The solution registers AI agents as first-class identities within enterprise IAM infrastructure, standardizing authentication and access management for digital labor.

top_stories.title: Massive Microsoft 365 outage causes auth issues, service failures
top_stories.summary: Microsoft experienced a massive Microsoft 365 outage causing authentication failures and service disruptions for Exchange Online customers. The incident affected auth systems and prompted an active investigation by Microsoft.

top_stories.title: 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
top_stories.summary: A phishing-as-a-service kit called "NovaCookies" enables adversary-in-the-middle attacks against Microsoft 365 sessions for $320 per month. The service steals session cookies rather than just credentials, allowing attackers to bypass MFA protections by hijacking authenticated sessions.

top_stories.title: LastPass enhancements improve visibility, governance, and control
top_stories.summary: LastPass announced a series of product innovations focused on access management, visibility, governance, and control in response to AI-driven threats. The enhancements include new tools to simplify access management and improvements aimed at delivering more value to existing customers.

top_stories.title: NIS2 compliance: Fixing IAM and access control before the 2026 audit
top_stories.summary: An article from Help Net Security outlines NIS2 Directive compliance requirements with a focus on IAM and access control ahead of 2026 audit deadlines. The piece covers obligations related to credential management and access controls, with EU member states moving into enforcement phases and non-compliance penalties reaching up to €10 million.

news.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
news.summary: A threat actor deployed infostealers to steal session tokens and gain unauthorized access to Claude accounts belonging to Anthropic users. The attack involved session hijacking techniques to bypass authentication on the AI platform.

news.title: File servers are here to stay. Here’s how to manage them securely
news.summary: tenfold Software published a guide outlining five best practices for managing file server access securely, focusing on least-privilege principles. The article addresses permission management and access control challenges in file server environments.

news.title: Threat actors are posing as AI crawlers to hunt for exposed credentials
news.summary: Threat actors are masquerading as AI web crawlers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Perplexity to scan websites for exposed credentials and configuration files, according to GreyNoise research. The attack exploits the fact that User-Agent strings in HTTP requests are unverifiable, allowing attackers to blend malicious scanning traffic with legitimate AI crawler activity.

news.title: AWS Console Private Access can block sign-ins to personal accounts
news.summary: AWS Console Private Access became generally available on August 28, allowing the AWS Management Console to load entirely within a VPC with no public internet path, routing authentication flows and API calls through PrivateLink endpoints. The feature enables organizations to block sign-ins to personal AWS accounts by restricting console access to approved corporate identities only.

news.title: Securing Claude Code: The New Compliance API, Local Visibility, and Identity Governance
news.summary: Anthropic has introduced Compliance API endpoints for Claude Code, giving security teams visibility into AI agent activity including file access, shell commands, and credential usage. The article uses this as a basis to discuss identity governance challenges around AI agents operating with developer credentials.

news.title: China-Linked Fire Ant Hijacks Cisco Routers to Steal Credentials and Blind Security Logs
news.summary: A China-linked threat actor called Fire Ant has expanded its espionage campaign to compromise Cisco IOS XR routers, TACACS authentication servers, and Linux management hosts. The attackers are targeting credential theft and disabling security logging on infrastructure used for authentication and network access management in high-value networks.

news.title: AI agents that pass authentication can still drift, expose data, or get memory-poisoned
news.summary: AI agents that successfully pass authentication can still pose security risks through behavioral drift, data exposure, and memory poisoning attacks. The article highlights that authentication alone is insufficient to secure AI agents, raising challenges around authorization, access control, and runtime behavior monitoring.

news.title: Huntoso – Eliminate standing access with zero-trust PAM on Entra ID
news.summary: Huntoso offers a Privileged Access Management (PAM) solution built on Microsoft Entra ID that implements zero-trust principles by eliminating standing access. The product targets organizations seeking to reduce persistent privileged credentials through just-in-time access controls integrated with Entra ID.

news.title: Grew Remaining Performance Obligations 17% While Revenue Rose 11%. Is the Platform Reaccelerating?
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 2027 financial results with revenue rising 11% year over year to $805 million. Remaining Performance Obligations grew 17%, suggesting a potential acceleration in bookings for the IAM vendor.

news.title: Okta (OKTA) Grew Remaining Performance Obligations 17% While Revenue Rose 11%. Is the Platform Reaccelerating?
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 2027 financial results with revenue rising 11% year over year and remaining performance obligations growing 17%. The results indicate a potential bookings recovery for the identity and access management platform vendor.

news.title: Okta Just Jumped 29%. AI Agents May Be Creating a New Bottleneck
news.summary: Okta's stock jumped 28.6% on August 27, closing at $172.91 after reporting better-than-expected earnings results and reaching a four-year high. The article examines how AI agents may be creating new identity and access management bottlenecks, positioning Okta for potential growth in managing non-human identities.

news.title: Key Reasons Why Identity Fabric Matters in 2026
news.summary: The article examines the concept of Identity Fabric as an architectural approach to unifying fragmented identity systems across cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure. It covers runtime visibility, unmanaged identity risks, and the growing relevance of identity fabric frameworks as enterprise access environments become more complex.

news.title: CrowdStrike and Okta Soar as AI Could Create “About 90” New Identities Per Worker
news.summary: CrowdStrike and Okta stocks rose amid projections that AI could create approximately 90 new identities per worker, significantly expanding the identity management landscape. The growth forecast highlights increasing demand for IAM and cybersecurity solutions as AI agents and automated processes require their own managed identities.

news.title: A Deadline No One Can Negotiate Is Coming for the World’s Encryption, and the Race to Get Ready Has Quietly Begun
news.summary: Quantum Secure Encryption Corp issued a news commentary highlighting the looming threat of quantum computing to current encryption standards, including those protecting identity and authentication systems. The piece addresses the broader industry shift toward post-quantum cryptography, which directly impacts IAM infrastructure such as PKI, authentication protocols, and secure credential management.

news.title: Okta’s AI boom just created a new security problem
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 revenue of $805 million (up 11%), with the company highlighting AI agents as a new identity security challenge alongside traditional human user authentication. The article addresses how the rise of AI "workers" introduces new identity and access management concerns beyond conventional credential-based threats.

news.title: CrowdStrike and Okta shares soar as AI threats fuel cybersecurity spending
news.summary: CrowdStrike and Okta both beat quarterly financial estimates and raised forecasts, with Okta's shares rising sharply following its earnings report. The results reflect increased cybersecurity spending driven by AI-related threats, signaling strong market demand for identity and access management solutions.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian national Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions targeting Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem after a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection practices relevant to IAM and privileged access management teams.
